name: Hunter's Cisticola
rangeDescription: High mountains of western kenya, uganda, and northern tanzania
description: A large, plain cisticola with a reddish cap and two bands across the tail tip, one pale and one dark. Found in open montane habitats with thick herbaceous undergrowth, including forest edge, grassland, and heath, almost always in pairs or small groups.

name: Buru Friarbird
rangeDescription: Buru island (southern moluccas)
description: A large, entirely gray-brown honeyeater with a patch of dark facial skin and a long, slightly decurved, sharply pointed bill. Juveniles show a yellowish-green wash to wings and underparts.

name: Namaqua Sandgrouse
rangeDescription: Dry grassland of southern africa
description: A dumpy, short-legged, pigeon-like bird that shuffles awkwardly on the ground and flies in a fast and direct manner, singly or in groups. It has a long, pointed tail and sharply-pointed wings.

name: Caracas Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Coastal mountains of northern venezuela (aragua, miranda, and distrito federal)
description: Boldly patterned sparrow with black head and white eyebrow. Back and tail olive-yellow, underparts white; black band across chest.

name: Red Siskin
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia, northern venezuela, and southwestern guyana; local and threatened
description: A small bird with a unique color pattern. Red-and-black plumage of male is diagnostic; female is salmon-pink and gray.

name: Long-billed White-eye
rangeDescription: Mountains of pohnpei (eastern caroline islands)
description: Bizarre and unique-looking white-eye, endemic to Pohnpei, in Micronesia’s Caroline Islands. Pale brownish-olive overall, with orange legs and a long curved bill; the two other white-eyes on the island, Pohnpei White-eye and Caroline Islands White-eye, are gray and yellow respectively, and both have short bills.

name: Brahminy Starling
rangeDescription: Eastern afghanistan to bangladesh, southern nepal, india, and sri lanka
description: A small fawn-colored starling with a long wispy crest that usually lies limp over the back of its head, but the feathers on its cheek and upper breast stand up and away from its cheek. Its upperparts are gray and the dark tail is tipped in white.

name: Black-billed Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: New guinea, including d'entrecasteaux archipelago (off southeastern new guinea), and bismarck archipelago
description: A small-bodied, mostly brown dove with a long tail and a short stout black bill. Heavily barred tail and rump are diagnostic.

name: Mindoro Bulbul
rangeDescription: Philippines (mindoro and semirara)
description: A medium-sized bird of lowland and montane forest and more open wooded areas on Mindoro and Semirara. Dark brown on the upperparts and chest with a pale belly, a fairly long stout black bill, and a grayish head with faint streaks.

name: White-billed Starling
rangeDescription: Mountains of eritrea and ethiopia
description: A dark starling with an ivory-colored bill, a dark red eye, and large red panels in the wings. Males have a dark head and females a pale gray one.

name: Blue-streaked Lory
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (arafura sea)
description: A beautiful red parrot with scattered dark markings confined to the Tanimbar Islands. Entirely scarlet underneath, with a deep blue stripe through the eye, a red bill, a dark back and tail, and scattered red markings on dark wings.

name: Crestless Curassow
rangeDescription: Guyana to southern venezuela, eastern colombia, and adjacent northwestern brazil
description: Large, terrestrial bird of flood-prone lowland rainforest; generally shy and difficult to see. Note all-dark appearance and small, red bill.

name: Ogea Monarch
rangeDescription: Forest of ogea levu (southeastern fiji)
description: A small flycatcher, powder-blue above and buffy-orange below, with a smudged orange-blue face, a pale eye-ring, and pale tail tips. Prefers limestone forest, avoiding villages and disturbed areas.

name: Blackthroat
rangeDescription: West-central china (southeastern gansu, southwestern shaanxi, northern sichuan, and northern yunnan)
description: A somberly-colored robin which breeds in dense bamboo thickets. Male is slate-gray above (only a hint of blue may be detected in good lighting) with a white belly and black bib.

name: Spot-backed Antwren
rangeDescription: Far eastern colombia, southern venezuela, and northwestern amazonian brazil
description: Small canopy antwren with a long, graduated tail. Males are largely gray with a black crown and a bold white eyebrow; the black spots on the back can be difficult to see.

name: Slate-throated Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of eastern panama to northwestern ecuador
description: Uncommon from extreme eastern Panama to northwest Ecuador. Typical gnatcatcher shape: small and long-tailed.

name: Olivaceous Schiffornis
rangeDescription: Eastern venezuela, the guianas, and northeastern brazil north of the amazon river
description: Shy, furtive bird that is heard far more often than seen. Shaped like a large manakin; mostly plain greenish-brown with unique large-eyed look.

name: Grauer's Swamp Warbler
rangeDescription: Highland papyrus swamps of eastern democratic republic of the congo and adjacent rwanda and uganda
description: Nondescript, long-tailed, long-billed wetland warbler. There is a white eyebrow and dark spotting on the throat and breast.

name: Chatham Islands Parakeet
rangeDescription: Chatham islands (mangere and little mangare)
description: Medium-sized bright green parakeet mainly restricted to Mangere and Little Mangere Islands on the Chatham Islands of New Zealand. Note distinctive yellow crown above a red forehead.

name: New Caledonian Friarbird
rangeDescription: Forest of new caledonia, including maré and lifou (loyalty islands)
description: Large, vociferous honeyeater with a long, heavy bill. Typical friarbird plumage, mostly brown with grayer wings and tail, and paler plume-like feathers on the chest.
